mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park. The moon is in its waxing crescent phase, and while the ISS will pass overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Important news for voters: The City of Verona added two new polling locations in late 2023. You can find your specific voting place by visiting the My Vote Wisconsin website to ensure you head to the correct church, library, or city hall building on election day.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 events, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Reviewing local activity, on October 7, officers responded to a collision between a passenger vehicle and an e-moto on Basswood Avenue. The juvenile rider sustained minor injuries and his parents were cited for allowing an unauthorized minor to operate the electric motorcycle.
Today's delicious flavor is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
